description: This script generates a build timestamp file including the current Git commit hash and build time, used for tracking build information in a project.

methods.name: resolveGitHead
methods.description: Resolves the current Git HEAD commit hash by executing 'git rev-parse HEAD' in the specified directory.

methods.name: writeBuildStamp
methods.description: Creates a build stamp file in the 'dist' directory containing the build timestamp and current Git commit hash.
